datasets.title: Ring Nebula in visible light
datasets.description: ESA/Hubble's photograph of the Ring Nebula, in He II 469, H-beta 487, [O III] 502, continuum 645, H-alpha 656, [N II] 658 and [S II] 673 nm. It stands as one flat picture facing the Sun at the nebula's distance.
datasets.summary: A flat picture facing the Sun at the nebula's distance; nothing in it has depth.
